en.headline: MTR says police have identified tour guide in Tsim Sha Tsui fare-evasion case
en.dek: The rail operator is working with police and the Travel Industry Authority after footage showed more than 30 people exiting without tapping cards behind a guide on 23 August.
body: The MTR Corporation said on Thursday that police had identified a tour guide suspected of helping members of a travel group improperly exit Tsim Sha Tsui station last month.

The incident occurred at about 11pm on 23 August. Online footage showed groups of passengers following a woman believed to be their guide through an exit gate after she tapped her card, with an estimated 30 or more people leaving without paying the correct fare.

MTR said it was gathering evidence with the police and the Travel Industry Authority for possible prosecution. It strongly condemned fare evasion and reminded passengers that failing to pay the correct fare can result in a surcharge or court action under its by-laws.

zh.headline: 港鐵：警方已鎖定尖沙咀逃票事件導遊身份
zh.dek: 8月23日晚上有旅行團懷疑不正當出閘，估計逾30人未付正確車資，港鐵正與警方及旅監局蒐證跟進。
body: 港鐵公司周四表示，知悉警方已鎖定早前尖沙咀站逃票事件中涉事導遊的身份，正與警方及旅遊業監管局緊密合作，蒐集證據以作進一步跟進及可能檢控。
事件發生於8月23日晚上約11時，網上片段顯示一名懷疑導遊拍卡出閘後，多名乘客跟隨通過，估計逾30人未有繳付正確車資。
港鐵強調嚴厲譴責逃票行為，並提醒乘客未付正確車資屬違反港鐵附例，可被徵收附加費或檢控。
